title: Permission Sets / Positions lists: the row's Active switch deactivates at once, with no confirm and no toast — one click took a holder from 200 to 403; confirm a deactivation and name the holder count (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U03, the confirm only)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 权限集和岗位列表上的「启用」开关一点就停用，不确认也不提示；测试中一次误点让持有人从 200 变成 403。
- **要做：** 停用前确认，并写明「N 个用户将失去此权限」。测试员提议的「禁止停用管理员自己的权限集」是新门禁，**不**采纳。
- **完成标准：** 停用需要确认，确认框写明受影响人数。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U03** — the confirm only. The tester's second ask, refusing the deactivation of the admin's own set, is a new gate and is **not** adopted. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** Setup → Permission Sets and Positions lists, the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** the row's Active switch deactivates a set at once, with no confirm and no toast. Turning off `qa_fls_rep` took its holder from 200 to 403 in one click; the same switch sits on `sales_rep`, `system_admin` and `admin_full_access`. The tester deactivated a position by accident during the pass.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-03; [`14-access-permission-sets-deactivated.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/14-access-permission-sets-deactivated.png), [`12-access-positions-deactivated.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/12-access-positions-deactivated.png).

## Landing

- The console's metadata list row switch for `permission_set` and `position` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`). The holder count is the server's (`sys_user_permission_set` / `sys_user_position`), read when the confirm opens.
- ⛔ Out of scope by the ruling: any refusal of a deactivation (e.g. of the admin's own set). This card adds a confirm, never a gate.

## Done when

- Switching a permission set or position off asks first, naming how many users lose the access; Cancel leaves it on.
- Switching on needs no confirm. A toast confirms the change either way.
- Tests on both lists.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `deactivat`, `active switch`, `holder count`, `permission set`. 2 hits, both closed: #13304 (position preview) and #13091 (sharing-rule layout). Not on point. **New.**
